content.text:
I made four small cleanup commits. The crate was already in decent shape, so I stopped there. All tests pass, `cargo clippy --all-targets` is clean, and the tree is clean.

1. **`53eb8c6`, name the shared attribute ranges:** the visibility-timeout and delay limits were written out in two places. They are now constants, so the attribute check and the per-request check can't drift apart.
2. **`90f8d5b`, read required parameters with typed getters:** handlers called `require()` and then unwrapped with `.expect("required")`. New `required_string` and `required_integer` getters return the missing-parameter error themselves, which removes every such `expect` and a duplicate error builder. `require()` still runs first, so the order in which errors are reported is the same.
3. **`2d2c17f`, parse the command name into an enum:** dispatch used to match on strings. `Request::parse` now produces a `Command` enum, so the match is exhaustive. An unknown command still returns the same `InvalidRequest` error and message.
4. **`d5916ab`, move the FIFO checks of `SendMessage` into a function:** `send_message` mixed validation, FIFO rules, duplicate detection and enqueueing. A `fifo_ids` helper and a small `FifoIds` struct now hold the FIFO rules. The order of the checks is unchanged.

The `90f8d5b` commit first went in on a broken build, because a macOS `sed -i` failure didn't stop my command chain. I fixed it and amended the commit before moving on, so no broken commit remains in the history.

I left some things alone on purpose. Typed newtypes for message ids, receipt handles and arrival keys would touch most of `queue.rs` and the tests. The `dl.queue.clone()` in `receive_message` is needed to release the queue borrow. The `max_messages as usize` cast is safe because the value is capped at 10 upstream.

New `required_string` and `required_integer` getters return the missing-parameter error themselves, which removes every such `expect` and a duplicate error builder. `require()` still runs first, so the order in which errors are reported is the same.
3. **`2d2c17f`, parse the command name into an enum:** dispatch used to match on strings. `Request::parse` now produces a `Command` enum, so the match is exhaustive. An unknown command still returns the same `InvalidRequest` error and message.
4. **`d5916ab`, move the FIFO checks of `SendMessage` into a function:** `send_message` mixed validation, FIFO rules, duplicate detection and enqueueing. A `fifo_ids` helper and a small `FifoIds` struct now hold the FIFO rules. The order of the checks is unchanged.

I left some things alone on purpose. Typed newtypes for message ids, receipt handles and arrival keys would touch most of `queue.rs` and the tests.
